player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

invalid_move.wrong_format: You did not respond with valid '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: You specified an invalid source or target tower.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Eie ua fikisa ku katula o komputadolo ku thandu dia'nzo.
invalid_move.same_tower: Eie ua fikisa ku texi o komputadolo iê, phala kuiza ijimbuete ia mukuá.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Eie ua fikisa ku ta ka diski ia dikota bhu kaxi ka ka disiki iofele.

outcome.win: Nga mu ku ximana, ua batula o maka a lungu ni sabhalalu ia Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: O jimbandu ja ku bhilula, a ji sange. Eie ua te kiambote o mbandu ia {pct}% mu Kibhangelu C.
